name: 5F-CUMYL-P7AICA
summary: 5F-CUMYL-P7AICA (also known as CUMYL-5F-P7AICA or SGT-263) is a pyrrolo[2,3-b]pyridine-3-carboxamide based synthetic cannabinoid that has been sold as a designer drug. It was first identified by the EMCDDA in February 2015.

uses.text: 5F-CUMYL-P7AICA (also known as CUMYL-5F-P7AICA or SGT-263) is a pyrrolo[2,3-b]pyridine-3-carboxamide based synthetic cannabinoid that has been sold as a designer drug.

pharmacology.en: Little has been published about it. Like other synthetic cannabinoids, it is presumed to switch on the CB1 receptor in the brain, the same receptor THC acts on.
pharmacology.zh: 相關研究很少。一般推測它和其他合成大麻素一樣，會活化腦中的CB1受體，也就是THC作用的受體。
pharmacology.zhHans: 相关研究很少。一般推测它和其他合成大麻素一样，会活化脑中的CB1受体，也就是THC作用的受体。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, vomiting, agitation, anxiety, paranoia and confusion. They are far more dangerous than cannabis, with reports of seizures, psychosis, kidney injury, heart attacks and deaths, and regular use can lead to dependence and harsh withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的合成大麻素可能引起心跳急促、嘔吐、躁動、焦慮、多疑與意識混亂。它們比大麻危險得多，曾有癲癇發作、精神病、腎損傷、心臟病發作與死亡的報告，長期使用也可能導致成癮與嚴重的戒斷反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的合成大麻素可能引起心跳急促、呕吐、躁动、焦虑、多疑与意识混乱。它们比大麻危险得多，曾有癫痫发作、精神病、肾损伤、心脏病发作与死亡的报告，长期使用也可能导致成瘾与严重的戒断反应。

fact.en: Its core ring system, a pyrrolopyridine, is the same framework found in 7-azaindole, where one carbon of an indole ring is replaced by nitrogen.
fact.zh: 它核心的吡咯并吡啶環系，與7-氮吲哚的骨架相同，也就是把吲哚環的一個碳換成氮。
fact.zhHans: 它内核的吡咯并吡啶环系，与7-氮吲哚的骨架相同，也就是把吲哚环的一个碳换成氮。
